product.summary: A volunteer rota app for a food-bank charity: volunteers see and take shifts and deliveries; coordinators post shifts and match deliveries to drivers.

source.quote: We want a small app where volunteers can see open shifts, sign up for them and see the deliveries they have accepted.

evidence.value: Coordination runs on a spreadsheet, WhatsApp and phone calls today

source.quote: Today we coordinate them with a shared spreadsheet, a WhatsApp group and a lot of phone calls
Nothing has been built yet; this note is the start.
